title: Thumbnail shot
summary: The thumbnail decides whether people click. Make it bright, close and clear.
steps: Face and upper body in frame, eyes about one third from the top.
Bright, even light on the face. No strong shadows.
Clean background with nothing personal or identifying in view.
Check the preview on a phone. It's what most viewers see.

title: Framing and angles
summary: Camera at eye level or slightly above, steady, with room to move.
steps: Set the camera at eye level or a little above.
Leave some space above the head and at the sides for movement.
Use a second angle (side or wide) for goal moments, if the setup allows.
Ask: is this the best frame and lighting we could have tonight?

title: Position ideas
summary: Change the position between goals so the room never feels static.
steps: Seated close-up: best for chatting and reading the room.
Standing wide: for dances, outfit shows and goal moments.
Side profile: a simple change that refreshes the frame.
Over-the-shoulder look: works well as a small goal reward.
